prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Artwork-only layer for a modern textbook velocity-vector diagram.
Rendering mode: hybrid. The artwork contains the three vehicles only; a separate deterministic SVG will add all arrows, the scale and labels.
Input image: the extracted original Figure 31 is structural reference, not an image to reproduce with its marks and text.
The modern-edition text below is authoritative and overrides old source pixels.

Complete relevant modern-edition text:
匀速运动的速度是这样一个量，它在数值上等于物体在单位时间内所通过的路程。
速度等于路程除以时间，v = s / t。
例题：一架154型飞机从一个城市飞往另一个城市，所经的路程为2736千米，所用的时间为3.8小时。设飞机的运动是匀速的，试求飞机的速度。
物体的速度不仅用数值，并且还需用方向来表征。
例如，要想知道从出发城市起飞的飞机在飞行了两个小时之后将位于何处，就不仅需要知道它的速度是多大，还要知道它飞行的方向如何。
为了进行比较，我们举出几个没有方向的物理量的例子：时间、物体的体积、1立方厘米空气中的分子数等。
在图上，物体的速度用一个箭头来表示（图31）。

Draw exactly one unbranded passenger aircraft, one ordinary passenger car, and one three-axle cargo truck. Keep them clearly separated, completely visible, with no cropped wheels, wings or tail.
Use a clean contemporary full-color educational illustration, with natural material colors and restrained shading. No archival engraving, silhouettes, logos, flags, uniforms, writing or book texture.
Plain white background. No ground lines, motion trails, arrows, ticks, scale bars, axes, letters, words, numerals or other annotations anywhere in the artwork.

Composition for a 1536 by 1024 image:
Aircraft in the left half, pointing diagonally toward the upper right. Its nose should be near pixel (520, 430); leave clear white space extending from its nose toward pixel (980, 50). Keep the body and wings entirely inside the image.
Passenger car in the upper-right region, side view, pointing left. Put its nose near pixel (1000, 290). Leave clear white space immediately to the left of the nose for the left-pointing arrow.
Cargo truck in the lower-right region, side view, pointing right. Put its nose near pixel (1300, 740). Leave clear white space to the right for the right-pointing arrow.
Leave the lower-left region white for the separately drawn scale bar and its label.
Do not reproduce any text, arrow or scale from the reference. The deterministic layer will supply those items.
